findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "cancel_order" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_ticket_checkout_link · Public sink: book_room, draft_delivery_order · Destructive: track_order, delete_saved_location.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_ticket_checkout_link · Public sink: book_room, draft_delivery_order · Destructive: track_order, delete_saved_location

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
